extracted_factors.Label: Nickel Mining Expansion
extracted_factors.Description: The expansion of nickel mining operations across Indonesia to meet global demand for nickel.

extracted_factors.Label: Deforestation due to Nickel Mining
extracted_factors.Description: Increased deforestation as a result of expanded nickel mining activities, affecting the forest ecosystem.

extracted_factors.Label: Pollution from Mining Activities
extracted_factors.Description: Pollution of air, water, and soil due to nickel mining processes, impacting local habitats and human health.

extracted_factors.Label: Demand for Electric Vehicle Batteries
extracted_factors.Description: The rising global demand for nickel, especially for use in electric vehicle batteries.

extracted_factors.Label: Environmental Degradation
extracted_factors.Description: The degradation of natural ecosystems and biodiversity loss due to excessive nickel mining.

extracted_factors.Label: Regulatory Enforcement
extracted_factors.Description: The role of regulations and their enforcement in managing mining activities and ensuring environmental protection.

extracted_pain_points.description: Deforestation and habitat loss due to expanding nickel mining activities.
Water and soil pollution from mining activities impacting local communities and agriculture.
Insufficient enforcement of regulations leading to uncontrolled environmental damage.
Social displacement and disruption of local communities due to mining concessions.
Health risks from air pollution and exposure to toxic metals due to mining activities.
